seo.title: Cottages & Family Suite | The Udaisarovar, Lakeside Resort Udaipur
seo.description: Four elemental lake-view and pool-view cottages and a Family Suite on Udai Sagar, Udaipur, from ₹4,500 a night with breakfast. Book all 5 cottages or the whole resort.

intro.title: Four elements, one lake
intro.text: Five bedrooms in all: four elemental cottages named Air, Water, Earth and Fire, and a stone-finish Family Suite. Every stay includes breakfast, free parking, Wi-Fi and the Guest App for menus, food orders and timings.

rooms.name: Lake View Cottage
rooms.text: Three of the elemental cottages face Udai Sagar directly. Wake up to the lake and watch the sun set behind the Aravalli hills from your doorstep.

rooms.name: Pool View Cottage
rooms.text: The elemental cottage closest to the infinity pool, for guests who want to step straight from the bedroom into the water.

rooms.name: Family Suite
rooms.text: A stone-finish suite with a double bed and bunk beds, made for families travelling together.

buyout.label: The whole resort
buyout.title: Make it yours
buyout.text: For family reunions, friends' getaways, weddings and private groups.

options.title: All five cottages
options.text: Every cottage and the Family Suite for your group, with all meals.

options.title: Full property buyout
options.text: All room keys plus the garden and function area, exclusively yours.

notes.title: Included
items: Guest App: menu, food orders, timings

notes.title: Good to know
items: Airport and railway transfers on request
GST: 5% up to ₹7,500 a night, 18% above
